ebooks.title: Manual for Court of Appeal Rules, 2009 as Amended
ebooks.description: This Manual intends to offer that assistance and reduce the gap that presently exists in the availability of legal literature to lawyers, academics and members of the public at large.

ebooks.title: Litigation-The Art of Strategy and Practice
ebooks.description: The book is not meant to be the final solution to all practical legal problems but rather seeks to provide a quick reference to the common topical issues the litigator faces in court.

ebooks.title: Marriage Laws in Africa
ebooks.description: This volume consists of a reprint of parts of a work published in 1953 under the title Survey of African Marriage and Family Life, with the addition of new material covering developments during the last two decades.

ebooks.title: Swearing by Kenya
ebooks.description: The book takes over from where the ‘Postponed Promise’ left and delves into the many attempts that were made to ‘jump start’ the stalled review culminating into the 2007/2008 post-election pogrom whose dire consequences became the basis for creating a body christened the ‘Committee of Experts’ to help midwife the difficult birth.

ebooks.title: Theoretical Foundations of Land Law in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book deals with a range of topical issues in Land Law. It makes an important contribution and is a breakthrough in an area which requires more literature on the evolving trends of Land Law regimes in the country. Since the pre-colonial era land has been a potential resource. Effective land management regime is a sustained concern of humankind ranging from traditional to more conventional approaches. The Government at different times has formulated rules to ensure effi cient land management and delivery systems in Tanzania. Bearing in mind that land has generally been associated with other resources, tenure rules have tended to be complicated.

ebooks.title: The Laws of Tanzania through Cases
ebooks.description: This book is intended for use by legal practitioners, be they judges and magistrates, advocates, members of the academic world, students of law and others who are interested in advancing their knowledge in contemporary legal matters.

ebooks.title: Public Law in Africa
ebooks.description: The East African region is getting to terms with the realities of Constitutional Order rooted under the principle of rule of law in a quest for good governance.

ebooks.title: Summary Judgment
ebooks.description: This book shows how courts interpret and apply Order 35 in Kenya and Tanzania and the corresponding Order 33 in Uganda. For brevity the nomenclature adopted here is by reference to Order 35 to include Uganda’s Order 33. It is a work on the East African summary judgment procedure in civil litigation.

ebooks.title: The Golden Rules of Wealth
ebooks.description: The Golden Rules of Wealth is a motivational work that seeks to spur your creative juices, to make you think and to remind you about the fundamental principles and rules you may have forgotten or ignored and to keep you focused on your goals. It is based on experience, research and on the teachings of very many teachers - both rich and poor- and from nature itself.

ebooks.title: The Law of Matrimonial Property in East Africa
ebooks.description: The law today recognizes the equality of a wife and a husband in owning a home. This is a complete departure from the historical practice especially in Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania where women could not hold property in their own right.

ebooks.title: A Text Book on Tax Law in Kenya
ebooks.description: A Text Book on Tax Law in Kenya is a treatise on Kenyan tax law. It is a reference book for the training of advocates, accountants, tax agents, consultants, business owners, public among other professionals interacting with tax matters. It is an indispensable handbook for any professional pursuing a career in tax including the decision makers, Judges, Magistrates, and Tax Tribunals. It is an extensive summary of the tax law in Kenya and the tax jurisprudence emanating from Kenyan Courts and Tax Appeal Tribunal.

ebooks.title: Conveyancing and Disposition of Land in Tanzania: Law and Procedure
ebooks.description: Conveyancing and Disposition of Land in Tanzania: Law and Procedure is a book that covers a range of topical issues in the subject of land transfer. It builds on the more theoretical aspects of transfer to the more practical aspects of land transfer in a right of occupancy system. It deals with transfer of rights and interests in land. Thorough understanding of the concepts in this book requires background knowledge on the rights and interest enjoyed on land that can be the subject of transfer.

ebooks.title: A Guide to the Laws of Kenya
ebooks.description: This “A Guide to The Laws of Kenya”, it is hoped, will enable all enquiring Kenyans to understand and appreciate the basic and rudimentary laws of our country. Hopefully, the book will help all Kenyans appreciate the laws better and by doing so citizens will be able to enforce their rights, obtain redress meaningfully and make the Kenyan society a proud one in which to prosper.

ebooks.title: Multipartyism, Constitutions and the Law in Africa
ebooks.description: African states must fashion political systems and constitutional models to suit their politics and history. The objectives of this study may be summarized as follows: (i) to explain the failure, in Africa during the 1960s, of multiparty system based on the liberal concept of democracy, (ii) to describe the present drive for multipartyism in Africa by identifying underlying forces, internal and external, for multipartyism , (iii) to analyze constitutional and legal steps that have been taken to date to accommodate multipartyism, (iv) to theorize on the role of the state vis-a-vis civil society in the consolidation of multipartyism for democratization and (v) to identify constitutional, legal and extralegal safeguards for the succss and sustenance of multipartyism i Africa.

ebooks.title: Partnership Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: The need for a specialist text on Partnership Law in Uganda has for long been felt. This is due not only to the fact that most business activities in Uganda are either conducted individually or in partnership but also to the distinct recognition of a discipline, apart from company law, which is normally lumped together with company law as the Law of Business Associations.

ebooks.title: Employment Law Guide for Employers - Revised Edition
ebooks.description: The Industrial Court does in its endeavour to interpret the various sections of labour statutes. However, majority of these guidelines have not been made accessible to employers in a manner that is easily and properly understood and appreciated. This is because, even though there is an attempt to avail the decisions of the Industrial Court to the general public, the ratios and the guidelines thereof have not been analyzed in a short, concise and easier manner. This book seeks to address this gap by focusing on the realist perspective.

ebooks.title: Intellectual Property Law in East Africa
ebooks.description: The past half century in Uganda has witnessed both concern and interest in copyright and neighbouring rights. This is evident in the laws and treaties initiated by both the Uganda Government and the international community, aimed at enabling copyright holders to realize the benefi ts of their intellectual works.

ebooks.title: Cases and Statutes on Evidence in Sierra Leone
ebooks.description: The Law of Evidence in Sierra Leone is largely the common law as introduced in this jurisdiction in colonial days with few inroads made by statutes on the common law principles. As such though the majority of the cases were decided in the 1960s and 1970s they are still of binding effect.

ebooks.title: Devolution in Kenya: A Commentary
ebooks.description: The adoption of the 2010 Constitution by Kenyans resulted in a multifaceted governance structure, and a complex system of intergovernmental relationships, under a devolved government. It marked the ultimate realisation of the aspiration of the Kenyan people for the devolution of governance powers and functions under a new social contract. This publication is a timely, valuable and highly commendable assemblage of well researched essays on Kenya’s system of devolved governance.

ebooks.title: The Exodus of Law and Legal Methods
ebooks.description: The gradual development of law in East Africa has been persistently eminent, contrary to the perceived views and critiques of legal methods. This book articulates a subsequent history of various legal disciplines in the East African region and lays down a firm foundation of law in the region. It is to make substantive law subjects for fresh law scholars more effective and to encourage a more rounded approach to the study of law.

ebooks.title: Dictionary of Criminology
ebooks.description: In professional disciplines, just as in academics, the definition of basic concepts is fundamental for adequate understanding of issues. A dictionary of criminology may be regarded as irrelevant for the simple reason that criminology cannot be said to constitute an academic or professional discipline in East Africa. But this dictionary is not limited to criminological or sociological concepts alone. Just like any academic discipline, it covers other areas of social studies such as law, economics and politics.

ebooks.title: Arbitration Law and Practice in Kenya
ebooks.description: In this book, the authors have focused on the salient principles of both substantive and procedural law governing arbitration in Kenya. As the economy grows disputes between investors will gradually increase. Besides, the growth of regional and sub-regional trade agreements and the proliferation of bilateral investment treaties will spur the emergence of disputes that require resolution through arbitration.

ebooks.title: Employment and Industrial Relations Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: By 2006, labour and Employment laws in Uganda had been crying out for a new breath of life. In April 2006, the government of Uganda enacted a number of labour laws and for the first time in the history of this country, fundamental pro-worker laws were passed to reflect the already recognized internationally labour standards.

ebooks.title: Tax and Development: Solving Kenya’s Fiscal Crisis through Human Rights
ebooks.description: For most people, taxation is a dry and boring technical topic. Yet taxes are an essential foundation for a civilised society.

ebooks.title: The Ideal Lawyer
ebooks.description: The book benchmarks an ideal lawyer and the standards that every lawyer must strive to achieve. It covers in great detail the practical aspects of legal practice, which are not taught at the Law School, yet play a critical role in moulding one into a competent lawyer. It formulates the pillars upon which effective legal practice is founded. It gives the categories into which law is divided, the history of the legal profession, factors to consider when choosing a place to undergo pupilage training or mentorship, and offers useful suggestions on how to set up a successful legal career.

ebooks.title: Supreme Court of Kenya Case Digest
ebooks.description: This book is a digest of decided cases at the Supreme Court of Kenya. It exposes the ratio decidendi in each and every decided case with the aim of guiding legal practioners on all aspects of the current jurisprudence and practice in the Supreme Court of Kenya.

ebooks.title: Criminology in Africa
ebooks.description: Criminology in Africa has been produced with contributions from leading African authors who have focussed on the various problems facing Africa today regarding crime and criminal justice, and they have, at the same time, put forward their ideas and suggestions for coming to terms with these massive problems

ebooks.title: Accounting for Lawyers
ebooks.description: This book recognizes the fear faced by many law students and to a great extent the practicing lawyer concerning accounting and seeks to provide a basic and simplifi ed understanding to accounting principles for those who have no previous accounting background while at the same time introducing some advanced topics for students with previous exposure and thus a deeper scope of accounting principles. The book also sought to incorporate key accounting principles and relevant changes and developments in the Kenyan industry. A comprehensive glossary of terms has been provided to assist learners in grasping key meanings and explanations

ebooks.title: How to Pass Exams
ebooks.description: This is a highly motivated and quick-reference guide to essential information that every candidate needs.

ebooks.title: The Administration of Justice in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book is a report of Tanzania Judges’ workshop that was held in Dar es Salaam from 2 to 5 June 2010. It was attended by Justices of the Court of Appeal of Tanzania and judges of the High Courts of Tanzania and the Republic of Ireland. The workshop was one of the series of continuing legal education sessions for judges. All such sessions have been organized by the University of Dar es Salaam School of Law (Formerly Faculty of Law) in collaboration with Trinity College, Dublin.

ebooks.title: Procedure in the Law of Succession in Kenya - Revised Edition
ebooks.description: One of the difficulties courts have been having in the past in dealing with the Law of Succession Act, had been with the issue of marriage. The Succession Act and the Marriage Act were to have come into operation simultaneously. This did not occur until almost 50 years later. The Marriage Act was gazetted on the 6 May 2014. Parliament amended and consolidated “the various laws relating to Marriage and Divorce and to connected purposes.”

ebooks.title: Revenue Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: This work is a pioneering text on revenue law in Uganda. In its nearly 50 years of Independence, no text on revenue law has ever been produced. Yet, since 1991 when the Uganda Revenue Authority was set up, there has been increasing interest in revenue issues as the tax paying culture among Ugandans is revived. The importance of an appreciation of revenue law, which is the basis of taxation, is therefore, obvious.

ebooks.title: The Legal Profession in Tanzania: The Law and Practice
ebooks.description: This book is a study of the Law and practice relating to the private Legal Profession in Tanzania.

ebooks.title: Civil Procedure and Practice in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book seeks to provide a means of understanding the concepts of civil litigation, promoting an understanding of fundamental principles involved, so that the various rules which govern civil litigation can be more easily understood and applied.

ebooks.title: Professional Ethics: A Kenyan Perspective
ebooks.description: Professional rules are strict because the standards that are expected of a professional are much higher than the standards expected of other people in other occupations not categorized as professions.

ebooks.title: Research Methodology Simplified
ebooks.description: Research demands that one who chooses to engage in it adheres to the guidelines. Based on this, several perspectives, beliefs and attitudes have been formed.

ebooks.title: Principles of Company Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book examines the fundamental principles which underlie company law first explored in the English case of Salomon. It explores the nature of company and what goes on behind the corporate veil; the duties and liabilities of directors; articles of association and memorandum of association; issues of authority; shareholders’ rights and remedies; corporate insolvency rules and corporate governance principles. It focuses on the Partnership Act, 2010, Insolvency Act, 2011, the Companies Act, 2012 and relevant decided court cases.

ebooks.title: Criminal Homicide in Uganda
ebooks.description: Violence has been common in the past, and it is common in most contemporary societies today. Collective violence in the form of wars and civil riots, as well as in political upheavals, may involve thousands of individual acts of assault, murder, and arson. The origin and the nature of collective violence on the whole, however, differs markedly from individual acts of violence such as criminal homicide, assault, and forcible rape, all of which involve the accomplishment of a personal objective through a violent act, whether it is an argument, personal dispute, or sexual intercourse. Criminological research on crimes of violence has been carried out primarily in the developed countries, particularly in the United States, Great Britain, and Italy. From this research we have learned that most acts of violence grow out of an interaction situation in which the act comes to be defined as requiring violence and in which the victim plays a part in precipitating the resulting action.

ebooks.title: The Land Law of Tanzania: A Casebook
ebooks.description: This casebook has been prepared for University students for the LL.B degree. It is based on the Land Law I (LW 202) syllabus and course outline of the University of Dar es Salaam School of Law. It is intended that the corresponding course content should be completed in the first semester of the second year. The period covered is 1901 to 2010. At the end of each judgment there are questions in order to guide the law student. The casebook can be used by Lecturers who employ the lecture method of delivery. Similarly, it can easily be employed by Lecturers who prefer the Socratic method.

ebooks.title: The New Constitutional Law of Kenya
ebooks.description: The new constitutional law of Kenya: principles, government and human rights, is tailored to unveil to the reader the fundamental normative and institutional frameworks of Kenya’s new Constitution. Not only does the book defi ne key concepts in constitutional law generally, but it also details how government in Kenya has been restructured and re-organised to give effect to the traditional principles that form the basis of constitutional law. The golden thread that cuts across the various chapters of the book is the emphasis that good constitutions anchor certain tenets that have garnered recognition as hallmarks of democratic dispensation.

ebooks.title: Understanding Negligence and Strict Liability
ebooks.description: Over past decades nobody of law within the civil justice system has experienced greater ferment than the law of torts. Particularly, the law relating to negligence and strict liability, as it is an “everyday accident” that courts address. In agreement with received jurisprudential wisdom, the authors maintain that there is no grand theory that will satisfactorily differentiate or explain the dynamic interactions of change between tort law, negligence and the law relating to strict liability.

ebooks.title: Concept of Civil Procedure in Kenya
ebooks.description: The book lays emphasis on the understanding of the civil law and how the courts of law have interpreted it hence showing a recap of ratio decidendi decided on by the courts of law. A wider interpretation of the civil procedure rules has been echoed on to enable scholars and researchers understand the law with minimal efforts to their research.

ebooks.title: Contract Law
ebooks.description: Contract law is the foundation of all commercial law. It is a subject that law students meet in their first year of study. This book is intended as an introduction to the law that governs contracts in Kenya. While the common law of England continues to play an important role, there is a rich jurisprudence and an array of Kenyan cases that have significantly contributed to the law, a number of which have been discussed. This book is largely aimed at undergraduate students of law; as such, it takes a more descriptive, rather than a critical approach explaining the law as it is, though practitioners and lecturers of law will also find it useful. There have also been some changes in legislation that will undoubtedly have an impact or encroach on contract. The most significant in this regard is perhaps the Consumer Protection Act, 2012, in so far as consumer transactions are concerned.

ebooks.title: Slavery and Colonialism
ebooks.description: Slavery as a universal social institution was transformed into a lucrative international trade in 1441 when 12 Africans were captured in a raid on the Atlantic Coast of Africa. The captives were taken to Prince Henry the Navigator as a gift.

ebooks.title: Civil Procedure in Tanzania: A Student’s Manual
ebooks.description: Few areas of the law in East Africa suffer from as much a dearth of local textbooks as the Civil Procedure Law. This is often a handicap to a student; he often has no alternative but to rely on statutory provisions covering the subject and on Indian and English law. This book is an attempt to fill that void. It is, of course, not an exhaustive work on the subject, but it covers, in as concise a form as possible, most of the basic principles of the law of Civil Procedure as contained in local statutes and decisions of superior courts. Inevitably, owing to a dearth of local authorities on some topics, reference has also been made to English and Indian authorities where these have appeared to be sufficiently relevant to East Africa.

ebooks.title: A Commentary on the Evidence Act Cap 80
ebooks.description: This Textbook is an authoritative, comprehensive and highly readable introduction to the law of evidence in Kenya. It is a systematic and balanced commentary on the Evidence Act Cap. 80 written with great clarity and conciseness. It covers all major topics in the law of evidence in sufficient detail but avoids being superfluous. This book is recommended reading for the able and enquiring student and a convenient reference work for practitioners of the law of evidence.

ebooks.title: A Guide to Criminal Procedure in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book has been written primarily for Police Officers, Public Prosecutors and Magistrates who bear the main responsibility for enforcing the law and administration of criminal justice. Police Officers will find the Chapters on Police Investigations, arrest, searches, and charges of special interest. Public Prosecutors should derive ample guidance from the Chapters on conduct of public prosecutions, control of public prosecutions, constitutional rights of accused persons, attendance of witness, conduct of trial before Magistrates’ Courts, and examination of witness. Magistrates should benefit by reading especially chapters on jurisdiction, pleas, bail, conduct of trials, preliminary proceedings, judgment, appeals and sentencing process.

ebooks.title: The Constitution of Kenya: Contemporary Reading
ebooks.description: The Constitution of Kenya: Contemporary Reading, which contains chapters written by legal experts, some of whom are renowned scholars, is a timely and a pioneering volume, particularly following the promulgation of the new Constitution of Kenya in 2010. The new Constitutional dispensation has ushered in a new epoch in Kenya replete with uncertainties and potential challenges. The chapters take the legal regime debate to a new level, by examining in a holistic perspective, the nexus between the critical issue areas and the new constitution.

ebooks.title: The Design of Micro Credit Contracts and Micro Enterprise Access to Finance in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book seeks to establish why, despite measures aimed at improving access to micro-credit, the majority of micro-enterprises in Uganda opt for informal rather than formal sources of credit.

ebooks.title: Criminal Law
ebooks.description: This text is designed to expose the Kenyan law on criminal responsibility and to define the common and key offences created by Kenyan statutes. An attempt has been made to rely mainly on Kenyan case law, but there is reference to cases from the other East African countries and the rest of the Commonwealth. The book is meant for law students undertaking the LL.B. programme. Legal practitioners, judicial officers, law enforcement agents and other persons with an interest in criminal law and justice will also find it useful.

ebooks.title: An Outline of Criminal Procedure in Kenya
ebooks.description: This book is written for Law Students, Practitioners, Judicial Officers and Academics. It is written as a Handbook to be resorted to for quick reference. At the same time, it provides comprehensive treatment of the subject. Elucidation, analysis and exposition of basic requirements of procedure and aspects of criminal law, criminology and penology that are germane have been employed and dovetailed to help deal with Kenyan Criminal Procedure.

ebooks.title: Women’s Law and Grassroots Justice in Uganda
ebooks.description: This posthumous publication is a collection of essays some of which are based on the author’s research work while others record her thoughts on issues she regarded as important. The idea to publish these works was that of the author herself although the time for publication would have been different. The materials, which were written between 1991 and 1996, cover a range of subjects that have been tied together under the theme of women, law and justice in Uganda. They represent the author’s central concerns, interests and views as they developed over the years.

ebooks.title: Employment and Labour Law Relations in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book consists of 'the new Labour Law of Tanzania'. It contains interesting contributions drawing together a wide range of labour law pedigree influence by two major sets of colonial legacy, Germany and British.

ebooks.title: Digest on Industrial Court Case Law
ebooks.description: This Digest endeavours to summarise the holdings of various Judges of the Industrial Court and further, exclusively narrows down to summarizing the pertinent ratio decidendi in select decided cases at the Industrial Court between the period May 2012 when the new court commenced operation to December 2013, conveniently divided into topics and sub-titles for ease of reference.

ebooks.title: A Commentary on the Civil Procedure Act Cap 21
ebooks.description: This book presents a detailed and practical explanation of the law of Civil Procedure in Kenya. It is designed primarily as a textbook for the undergraduate and Bar candidate in universities and related institutions. The book discusses the principles of Civil Procedure Law in an easily grasped and comprehensive format in a practical setting making it also useful to members of the Bar and Bench. The Second Edition has been thoroughly revised.

ebooks.title: A Casebook on the Law of Succession
ebooks.description: This text broadly and comprehensively covers the area of law of succession in Kenya. It exposes the substantive succession legal regime applying in Kenya as well as the Kenyan probate practice by way of case law and materials. It is tailored specifically for the legal practitioner, the Magistrate and Judge and the law student.

ebooks.title: Administration of Justice in Mainland Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book aims to provide a clear exposition of the nature, structure, practice and procedure of the courts in Mainland Tanzania. It provides a detailed exposition of and discussion on the nature and structure and the main areas of practice and procedure of the Courts.

ebooks.title: Child Rights and the Law in East Africa
ebooks.description: The book seeks to streamline the rights and protection of children in the three common law East African countries through law both now and in the future. The book also serves as a resource material in the area of child rights and the law, not only in East Africa, but also across Sub-Saharan Africa. It further seeks to stimulate debate on effective domestication and implementation of international child rights standards in East Africa.

ebooks.title: African Customary Law: Developing an African Jurisprudence
ebooks.description: The dichotomy between the State laws and the reflection of true African social life of the people is quite eminent. Certain legal values that have been enshrined by the ancestors and have been persistently passed on from one generation to the next by elders, through oral traditions, have been binding on the members of respective communities from time immemorial. Reviving the long debate on the need for the study of the African customary law therefore is timely and worthwhile.

ebooks.title: Crime and Deviance
ebooks.description: The main objective of the first edition is to make available a simplified, readily available introductory reader not only for the students of Criminology, but also for the general reader who may be interested in the problems of crime, crime control and prevention.

ebooks.title: Annotated Civil Procedure and Practice in the Court of Appeal of Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book serves as a resource material in the area of administration of civil justice in the Court of Appeal of Tanzania. It also seeks to stimulate debate on the development of jurisprudence of the Court of Appeal in the administration of civil justice and on how the Court has applied its rules of procedure in appeals before it.

ebooks.title: Policing in Eastern Africa
ebooks.description: This book fills a large void in teaching materials for policing and law enforcement courses in higher education institutions, where Criminology and Security Studies/Management is quickly gaining recognition as an academic discipline. The book begins by providing an overview of the context of East African policing, highlighting policing in Rwanda, Uganda, and Tanzania. It then systematically traces the history of policing and law enforcement in Kenya.

ebooks.title: Trans-Boundary Resource Cooperation in the Lake Victoria Basin
ebooks.description: This book inquires into the effectiveness of regional and international environmental law frameworks in the Lake Victoria Basin. Such an inquiry in the context of trans-boundary resource co-operation in the Lake Victoria Basin brings to light the anodyne nature of the legal framework and institutions responsible for effective management and trans-boundary co-operation. It is clear however that the solution lies not in the adoption of more laws to regulate diverse transboundary aspects of the Lake Victoria Basin but rather in initiating a strong political process that will eventually enhance the quality of extant laws as well as the reach of institutional implementation.

ebooks.title: Know your Law: A Citizen’s Handbook to Everyday Law
ebooks.description: This book is intended to enlighten those who may find themselves in a tricky legal dilemma and a lawyer is not readily at hand to offer first aid legal services. There is no price to education and there’s no monopoly on legal education and not everybody will be a lawyer.

ebooks.title: Principles for the Bar Exam
ebooks.description: The bar examination is structured into three parts: the written examination, the project work, and the oral examination and they are weighted at 60%, 20%, and 20% which cumulatively becomes 100%. This book is an attempt to provide the principles a student can rely on in their pursuit of success in the bar examination.

ebooks.title: Principles of Commercial Law
ebooks.description: This textbook is designed to equip students of law and other professional pursuits with easily accessible and comprehensive legal text and materials in the law of contract generally, and in the various topical elements of special contracts and commercial law. The book is tailored to cover the various syllabi and to meet the needs of university and tertiary college students of all disciplines in which contract and commercial laws form part of their curricula.

ebooks.title: White Collar Crime in Uganda: Corruption & Related Offences
ebooks.description: The book underlines various legal provisions on the subject, including constitutional, statutory and common law. It takes you thru a step by step process in the procedural adjudication of judicial review in Uganda. It creates a comparative context with other jurisdictions about judicial review and highlights the importance of regulating administrative actions of public bodies.

ebooks.title: Social and Economic Rights in Kenya: Theory, Practice and Jurisprudence
ebooks.description: This book dares to question: Is Article 43 of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010 a lyrical masterpiece awaiting realization, or, can its radiant clauses be transformed into actionable policies of a binding nature? The discourse herein invites the reader to embark on a journey through schorlarly boulevard that explores the mosaic of socio-economic rights, unravelled with eloquence, juxtaposed against the canvas of Kenya's legal landscape and economic realities and enriched with comparative perspectives from analogous jurisdictions.

ebooks.title: Public International Law
ebooks.description: This text on Public International Law is a product of the author's experience as a lecturer of Public International Law and other branches of this independent legal system. The book also responds to a vacuum which has existed and continues to exist in the scholarship of Public International Law, particularly in Kenya and the African Continent in general. It is an attempt to fill this gap and to do so from a perspective which is much closer to the environment where it is written and reflects some of the realities on the ground. It will hopefully assist both scholars and students of international law, in their study and research. It has also covered some branches of international law often untouched, for example, the International Sports Law.

ebooks.title: Practising an Honourable Profession
ebooks.description: This book is about practice, written by a practitioner. It is not a primer on the learning of the subjects of law. It is about the profession of the law in Kenya in particular, and East Africa in general. This is because the acquisition of experience in the practice of law is a discipline discrete from the acquisition of knowledge in a school of law. These then are thoughts for those just entering practice and those in their first fifteen years in it.

ebooks.title: Principles of Judicial Review in Uganda
ebooks.description: The tenets of judicial review are entrenched in our everyday legal practice and provide a correctional remedy to the ills of public administration. It is, therefore, important to appreciate the procedures involved and the salient principles to better support the purpose of administrative law.

ebooks.title: Method and Technique to the Bar Exam
ebooks.description: This book is a follow up to Principles for the Bar Exam. I have selected a few questions from the annual test papers of the Council of Legal Education and used them to show the minimum standards expected in your answers.

ebooks.title: Employment Law Guide for Employers
ebooks.description: The right to fair labour practices, fair remuneration, reasonable working conditions, non-discrimination, social security, to go on strike, to form, join or participate in the activities and programmes of trade unions, workers federations and employers’ unions are pivotal components of our individual development as human beings, the community, and the development of the nation.

ebooks.title: Law of Succession
ebooks.description: Law of succession is the branch of law that deals with inheritance to property. The concept of inheritance is universal to all societies irrespective of their cultural or historical background, ideology, religion or legal system.

ebooks.title: Luyia Customary Law
ebooks.description: Customary law has generally been described as a body of rules, customs, or traditions, considered binding upon them by the people or community to whom they refer. There is, however, no universally recognized definition of customary law, a term viewed by many as problematic. Its connection with ‘custom’ has, for example, been described as potentially confusing and suggestive of a wide range of traditional behaviours some of which ‘have nothing whatever to do with law’.

ebooks.title: Judicial Review Law Procedure and Practice - Third Edition
ebooks.description: This book presents the most current, comprehensive and authoritative account of Judicial Review Law in Kenya today. It combines the features of a textbook and a casebook at once. It refers to the most authoritative decisions of the Supreme Court, the Court of Appeal and the High Court on the substantive and procedural law principles under study; refers to cases, journals and materials from other commonwealth jurisdictions and appends necessary precedents for judicial review pleadings.

ebooks.title: Insurance Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book offers insights on Insurance Law from a Ugandan perspective taking into account the most recent developments. While the motivation for the text was providing a resource book for students, the book is intended for the wider audience of legal practitioners. Carefully selected cases, statutes, and reference materials have been analyzed in context to present the reader with a balanced and enriched perspective of Insurance Law.

ebooks.title: Constitutional Law, Doctrines and the Litigation of Fundamental Rights and Freedoms
ebooks.description: This book primary focus is on the fundamental rights and freedoms under international law and as enshrined in the Kenyan Constitution, 2010 as further encapsulated under various international law instruments and customs. The analysis in this book presents various judicial pronouncements on this field. It is the authors’ hope that students and constitutional law enthusiasts will find this piece of literature a useful guide in gaining a broader understanding of the area of human rights and fundamental freedoms.

ebooks.title: Handbook on Arbitration in Kenya
ebooks.description: Kenya’s leading ADR practitioners present this comprehensive handbook as a practical and authoritative guide to arbitration in Kenya. They examine the evolution of arbitration as a key dispute resolution tool and highlight its growing relevance in both domestic and international contexts.

ebooks.title: A Commentary on the Evidence Act, Cap. 80
ebooks.description: This textbook is an authoritative, comprehensive and highly readable introduction to the law of evidence in Kenya. It is a systematic and balanced commentary on the Evidence Act, Cap. 80 written with great clarity and conciseness. It covers all major topics in the law of evidence in sufficient detail but avoids superfluous detail.

ebooks.title: Admiralty and Maritime Law in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book covers the law of the Sea and various subjects on ships and shipping including ship ownership and registration, ship mortgages, admiralty jurisdiction, charter parties, slavage, the law covering seafarer's employment, marine liens, ship's liabilities, pollution, pilotage and the law covering ports.

ebooks.title: The Essence of Pupillage
ebooks.description: This book is a follow-up to Principles for the Bar Exam in which the author had set down the basic guidelines on how to tackle the bar exam. In the present book, the author covers the structure and conduct of pupillage in Kenya. It discusses the principles that should guide bar training in Kenya: the standards and principles applicable to pupils and the pupil masters, the styles of instruction, and the required qualities in a pupil seeking to be admitted to the Bar.

ebooks.title: Alternative Dispute Resolution: A Ugandan Court Experience
ebooks.description: This book contains re-edited work I presented at various fora as my personal re? ections on the subject of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR). In many ways, the work also chart my professional journey both as a lawyer and subsequently as a Judge in Uganda. Coming out of undergraduate law school, my sense of dispute resolution was quite narrowly focused around adjudication. Our training at law school sought to establish what legal rights existed and how they could be enforced in a court of law.

ebooks.title: Land Law and Conveyancing: Principles and Practice
ebooks.description: This book provides a careful presentation and analysis of land law and conveyancing in practice and lays a foundation for the development and further understanding of conveyancing processes in light of recent constitutional and statutory developments in Kenya. This book is an attempt therefore to assess the present state of land law and conveyancing while taking into account recent developments which include the promulgation of a novel constitutional order in 2010, the enactment of Land Act, 2012, the Land Registration Act, 2012, and the National Land Commission Act, 2012.

ebooks.title: Legal Practice Management
ebooks.description: This book seeks to illuminate the expansive nature of legal practice in the society. It is also aimed at provoking further debate, research and publication.

ebooks.title: Test Law Book
Policing in Eastern Africa
ebooks.description: This book fills a large void in teaching materials for policing and law enforcement courses in higher education institutions, where Criminology and Security Studies/Management is quickly gaining recognition as an academic discipline. The book begins by providing an overview of the context of East African policing, highlighting policing in Rwanda, Uganda, and Tanzania. It then systematically traces the history of policing and law enforcement in Kenya.

ebooks.title: How to Pass Exams
ebooks.description: This is a highly motivated and quick-reference guide to essential information that every candidate needs.

ebooks.title: Trans-Boundary Resource Cooperation in the Lake Victoria Basin
ebooks.description: This book inquires into the effectiveness of regional and international environmental law frameworks in the Lake Victoria Basin. Such an inquiry in the context of trans-boundary resource co-operation in the Lake Victoria Basin brings to light the anodyne nature of the legal framework and institutions responsible for effective management and trans-boundary co-operation. It is clear however that the solution lies not in the adoption of more laws to regulate diverse transboundary aspects of the Lake Victoria Basin but rather in initiating a strong political process that will eventually enhance the quality of extant laws as well as the reach of institutional implementation.

ebooks.title: Equity and Trusts - Revised Edition
ebooks.description: The book provides an overview of equitable principles in Uganda and links this with the maxims of equity and the distinction between equitable and legal interests. The book will benefit students offering Equity and Trusts and Estate Planning in East African universities as well as legal practitioners, insurance, social security and corporate operators.

ebooks.title: Litigation-The Art of Strategy and Practice
ebooks.description: The book is not meant to be the final solution to all practical legal problems but rather seeks to provide a quick reference to the common topical issues the litigator faces in court.

ebooks.title: Research Methodology Simplified
ebooks.description: Research demands that one who chooses to engage in it adheres to the guidelines. Based on this, several perspectives, beliefs and attitudes have been formed.

ebooks.title: Know your Law: A Citizen’s Handbook to Everyday Law
ebooks.description: This book is intended to enlighten those who may find themselves in a tricky legal dilemma and a lawyer is not readily at hand to offer first aid legal services. There is no price to education and there’s no monopoly on legal education and not everybody will be a lawyer.

ebooks.title: Principles for the Bar Exam
ebooks.description: The bar examination is structured into three parts: the written examination, the project work, and the oral examination and they are weighted at 60%, 20%, and 20% which cumulatively becomes 100%. This book is an attempt to provide the principles a student can rely on in their pursuit of success in the bar examination.

ebooks.title: Manual for Court of Appeal Rules, 2009 as Amended
ebooks.description: This Manual intends to offer that assistance and reduce the gap that presently exists in the availability of legal literature to lawyers, academics and members of the public at large.

ebooks.title: Principles of Company Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book examines the fundamental principles which underlie company law first explored in the English case of Salomon. It explores the nature of company and what goes on behind the corporate veil; the duties and liabilities of directors; articles of association and memorandum of association; issues of authority; shareholders’ rights and remedies; corporate insolvency rules and corporate governance principles. It focuses on the Partnership Act, 2010, Insolvency Act, 2011, the Companies Act, 2012 and relevant decided court cases.

ebooks.title: Principles of Commercial Law
ebooks.description: This textbook is designed to equip students of law and other professional pursuits with easily accessible and comprehensive legal text and materials in the law of contract generally, and in the various topical elements of special contracts and commercial law. The book is tailored to cover the various syllabi and to meet the needs of university and tertiary college students of all disciplines in which contract and commercial laws form part of their curricula.

ebooks.title: Supreme Court of Kenya Case Digest
ebooks.description: This book is a digest of decided cases at the Supreme Court of Kenya. It exposes the ratio decidendi in each and every decided case with the aim of guiding legal practioners on all aspects of the current jurisprudence and practice in the Supreme Court of Kenya.

ebooks.title: The Golden Rules of Wealth
ebooks.description: The Golden Rules of Wealth is a motivational work that seeks to spur your creative juices, to make you think and to remind you about the fundamental principles and rules you may have forgotten or ignored and to keep you focused on your goals. It is based on experience, research and on the teachings of very many teachers - both rich and poor- and from nature itself.

ebooks.title: Summary Judgment
ebooks.description: This book shows how courts interpret and apply Order 35 in Kenya and Tanzania and the corresponding Order 33 in Uganda. For brevity the nomenclature adopted here is by reference to Order 35 to include Uganda’s Order 33. It is a work on the East African summary judgment procedure in civil litigation.

ebooks.title: Theoretical Foundations of Land Law in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book deals with a range of topical issues in Land Law. It makes an important contribution and is a breakthrough in an area which requires more literature on the evolving trends of Land Law regimes in the country. Since the pre-colonial era land has been a potential resource. Effective land management regime is a sustained concern of humankind ranging from traditional to more conventional approaches. The Government at different times has formulated rules to ensure effi cient land management and delivery systems in Tanzania. Bearing in mind that land has generally been associated with other resources, tenure rules have tended to be complicated.

ebooks.title: The Law of Matrimonial Property in East Africa
ebooks.description: The law today recognizes the equality of a wife and a husband in owning a home. This is a complete departure from the historical practice especially in Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania where women could not hold property in their own right.

ebooks.title: Swearing by Kenya
ebooks.description: The book takes over from where the ‘Postponed Promise’ left and delves into the many attempts that were made to ‘jump start’ the stalled review culminating into the 2007/2008 post-election pogrom whose dire consequences became the basis for creating a body christened the ‘Committee of Experts’ to help midwife the difficult birth.

ebooks.title: Revenue Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: This work is a pioneering text on revenue law in Uganda. In its nearly 50 years of Independence, no text on revenue law has ever been produced. Yet, since 1991 when the Uganda Revenue Authority was set up, there has been increasing interest in revenue issues as the tax paying culture among Ugandans is revived. The importance of an appreciation of revenue law, which is the basis of taxation, is therefore, obvious.

ebooks.title: Public Law in Africa
ebooks.description: The East African region is getting to terms with the realities of Constitutional Order rooted under the principle of rule of law in a quest for good governance.

ebooks.title: The New Constitutional Law of Kenya
ebooks.description: The new constitutional law of Kenya: principles, government and human rights, is tailored to unveil to the reader the fundamental normative and institutional frameworks of Kenya’s new Constitution. Not only does the book defi ne key concepts in constitutional law generally, but it also details how government in Kenya has been restructured and re-organised to give effect to the traditional principles that form the basis of constitutional law. The golden thread that cuts across the various chapters of the book is the emphasis that good constitutions anchor certain tenets that have garnered recognition as hallmarks of democratic dispensation.

ebooks.title: Multipartyism, Constitutions and the Law in Africa
ebooks.description: African states must fashion political systems and constitutional models to suit their politics and history. The objectives of this study may be summarized as follows: (i) to explain the failure, in Africa during the 1960s, of multiparty system based on the liberal concept of democracy, (ii) to describe the present drive for multipartyism in Africa by identifying underlying forces, internal and external, for multipartyism , (iii) to analyze constitutional and legal steps that have been taken to date to accommodate multipartyism, (iv) to theorize on the role of the state vis-a-vis civil society in the consolidation of multipartyism for democratization and (v) to identify constitutional, legal and extralegal safeguards for the succss and sustenance of multipartyism i Africa.

ebooks.title: Partnership Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: The need for a specialist text on Partnership Law in Uganda has for long been felt. This is due not only to the fact that most business activities in Uganda are either conducted individually or in partnership but also to the distinct recognition of a discipline, apart from company law, which is normally lumped together with company law as the Law of Business Associations.

ebooks.title: Intellectual Property Law in East Africa
ebooks.description: The past half century in Uganda has witnessed both concern and interest in copyright and neighbouring rights. This is evident in the laws and treaties initiated by both the Uganda Government and the international community, aimed at enabling copyright holders to realize the benefi ts of their intellectual works.

ebooks.title: Conveyancing and Disposition of Land in Tanzania: Law and Procedure
ebooks.description: Conveyancing and Disposition of Land in Tanzania: Law and Procedure is a book that covers a range of topical issues in the subject of land transfer. It builds on the more theoretical aspects of transfer to the more practical aspects of land transfer in a right of occupancy system. It deals with transfer of rights and interests in land. Thorough understanding of the concepts in this book requires background knowledge on the rights and interest enjoyed on land that can be the subject of transfer.

ebooks.title: Understanding Negligence and Strict Liability
ebooks.description: Over past decades nobody of law within the civil justice system has experienced greater ferment than the law of torts. Particularly, the law relating to negligence and strict liability, as it is an “everyday accident” that courts address. In agreement with received jurisprudential wisdom, the authors maintain that there is no grand theory that will satisfactorily differentiate or explain the dynamic interactions of change between tort law, negligence and the law relating to strict liability.

ebooks.title: Women’s Law and Grassroots Justice in Uganda
ebooks.description: This posthumous publication is a collection of essays some of which are based on the author’s research work while others record her thoughts on issues she regarded as important. The idea to publish these works was that of the author herself although the time for publication would have been different. The materials, which were written between 1991 and 1996, cover a range of subjects that have been tied together under the theme of women, law and justice in Uganda. They represent the author’s central concerns, interests and views as they developed over the years.

ebooks.title: The Laws of Tanzania through Cases
ebooks.description: This book is intended for use by legal practitioners, be they judges and magistrates, advocates, members of the academic world, students of law and others who are interested in advancing their knowledge in contemporary legal matters.

ebooks.title: Employment Law Guide for Employers - Revised Edition
ebooks.description: The Industrial Court does in its endeavour to interpret the various sections of labour statutes. However, majority of these guidelines have not been made accessible to employers in a manner that is easily and properly understood and appreciated. This is because, even though there is an attempt to avail the decisions of the Industrial Court to the general public, the ratios and the guidelines thereof have not been analyzed in a short, concise and easier manner. This book seeks to address this gap by focusing on the realist perspective.

ebooks.title: Marriage Laws in Africa
ebooks.description: This volume consists of a reprint of parts of a work published in 1953 under the title Survey of African Marriage and Family Life, with the addition of new material covering developments during the last two decades.

ebooks.title: Tax and Development: Solving Kenya’s Fiscal Crisis through Human Rights
ebooks.description: For most people, taxation is a dry and boring technical topic. Yet taxes are an essential foundation for a civilised society.

ebooks.title: The Ideal Lawyer
ebooks.description: The book benchmarks an ideal lawyer and the standards that every lawyer must strive to achieve. It covers in great detail the practical aspects of legal practice, which are not taught at the Law School, yet play a critical role in moulding one into a competent lawyer. It formulates the pillars upon which effective legal practice is founded. It gives the categories into which law is divided, the history of the legal profession, factors to consider when choosing a place to undergo pupilage training or mentorship, and offers useful suggestions on how to set up a successful legal career.

ebooks.title: The Land Law of Tanzania: A Casebook
ebooks.description: This casebook has been prepared for University students for the LL.B degree. It is based on the Land Law I (LW 202) syllabus and course outline of the University of Dar es Salaam School of Law. It is intended that the corresponding course content should be completed in the first semester of the second year. The period covered is 1901 to 2010. At the end of each judgment there are questions in order to guide the law student. The casebook can be used by Lecturers who employ the lecture method of delivery. Similarly, it can easily be employed by Lecturers who prefer the Socratic method.

ebooks.title: The Exodus of Law and Legal Methods
ebooks.description: The gradual development of law in East Africa has been persistently eminent, contrary to the perceived views and critiques of legal methods. This book articulates a subsequent history of various legal disciplines in the East African region and lays down a firm foundation of law in the region. It is to make substantive law subjects for fresh law scholars more effective and to encourage a more rounded approach to the study of law.

ebooks.title: The Constitution of Kenya: Contemporary Reading
ebooks.description: The Constitution of Kenya: Contemporary Reading, which contains chapters written by legal experts, some of whom are renowned scholars, is a timely and a pioneering volume, particularly following the promulgation of the new Constitution of Kenya in 2010. The new Constitutional dispensation has ushered in a new epoch in Kenya replete with uncertainties and potential challenges. The chapters take the legal regime debate to a new level, by examining in a holistic perspective, the nexus between the critical issue areas and the new constitution.

ebooks.title: The Design of Micro Credit Contracts and Micro Enterprise Access to Finance in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book seeks to establish why, despite measures aimed at improving access to micro-credit, the majority of micro-enterprises in Uganda opt for informal rather than formal sources of credit.

ebooks.title: The Legal Profession in Tanzania: The Law and Practice
ebooks.description: This book is a study of the Law and practice relating to the private Legal Profession in Tanzania.

ebooks.title: The Administration of Justice in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book is a report of Tanzania Judges’ workshop that was held in Dar es Salaam from 2 to 5 June 2010. It was attended by Justices of the Court of Appeal of Tanzania and judges of the High Courts of Tanzania and the Republic of Ireland. The workshop was one of the series of continuing legal education sessions for judges. All such sessions have been organized by the University of Dar es Salaam School of Law (Formerly Faculty of Law) in collaboration with Trinity College, Dublin.

ebooks.title: Professional Ethics: A Kenyan Perspective
ebooks.description: Professional rules are strict because the standards that are expected of a professional are much higher than the standards expected of other people in other occupations not categorized as professions.

ebooks.title: Slavery and Colonialism
ebooks.description: Slavery as a universal social institution was transformed into a lucrative international trade in 1441 when 12 Africans were captured in a raid on the Atlantic Coast of Africa. The captives were taken to Prince Henry the Navigator as a gift.

ebooks.title: Procedure in the Law of Succession in Kenya - Revised Edition
ebooks.description: One of the difficulties courts have been having in the past in dealing with the Law of Succession Act, had been with the issue of marriage. The Succession Act and the Marriage Act were to have come into operation simultaneously. This did not occur until almost 50 years later. The Marriage Act was gazetted on the 6 May 2014. Parliament amended and consolidated “the various laws relating to Marriage and Divorce and to connected purposes.”

ebooks.title: Magistrate’s Manual
ebooks.description: This book, then, as its title suggests, is intended primarily for use by magistrates. But in view of the field it covers, it is hoped that it will be of interest to law students, lawyers and those who are interested in the mechanics and subtleties of our judicial machinery.

ebooks.title: Land Law and Conveyancing in Kenya
ebooks.description: LAND LAW AND CONVEYANCING IN KENYA deals with principles of Land Law and Conveyancing and treats the law as it is. The book is divided into three parts. Part One deals with substantive law in a very cohesive manner. Part Two analyses registration procedures and their effects. Part Three deals with every aspect of conveyancing in a most practical and detailed form. The author is able to bring into his study a lot of theoretical knowledge as well as much valuable practical experience.

ebooks.title: Legal Practice Management
ebooks.description: This book seeks to illuminate the expansive nature of legal practice in the society. It is also aimed at provoking further debate, research and publication.

ebooks.title: Measure of Damages for Bodily Injuries
ebooks.description: When claims are filed in courts, the measure of the quantum of damages to be awarded nearly always presents intricate problems. Broadly, the difficulty is double pronged: (1) which factors to take into account or ignore, and (2) what amount of money to award as damages. The first problem is a matter of legal principle, and is relatively less puzzling. The second problem is a matter of judgment upon given facts.

ebooks.title: Litigating Human Rights in African Institutions: Law, Procedures and Practice
ebooks.description: Africa boasts itself of having three Human Rights Institutions – the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights, the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child and the African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights. The three institutions are primarily charged with a majorfunction of promoting and protecting human and peoples’ rights, including child rights, at the continental level.

ebooks.title: Liberalization of Legal Education in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book analyses the liberalization of legal education and training in East Africa.

ebooks.title: Meetings: Law and Procedure in Kenya Today
ebooks.description: Meetings: Law and Practice in Kenya Today is a comprehensive guide to the law and practice of meetings in the present day Kenya.

ebooks.title: Essays in Criminology
ebooks.description: Crime in Africa is fast growing like African cities, African poverty, African indebtedness, African brain-drain and African dependence; everything in Africa appears to be growing very fast; population too has been fast growing except that it is being reduced by violence as we have witnessed in Rwanda, Burundi and Somalia and AIDS pandemic that is fi rst spreading in Africa, claiming thousands of lives every year.

ebooks.title: Latin Terms and Maxims Contextualised in Court Decisions
ebooks.description: The Text is divided into two sections. The f rst part provides, LatinEnglish terminologies, and the second part comprise of maxims and expressions. The terminologies, maxims and expressions are all arranged in alphabeticaly. The table of cases and statutes is useful for ease of reference to the various terms, maxims, expressions and statutes. The Text is complete with an index to assist find the various terminologies and maxims. The various abbreviations used are explained in full in the list of abbreviations.

ebooks.title: The Law and Practice of Evidence in Kenya
ebooks.description: This second edition of the Law and Practice of Evidence in Kenya has attempted to remove the glitches of the first edition as well as update the text to be at par with the current case law.

ebooks.title: Land Law and Conveyancing: Principles and Practice
ebooks.description: This book provides a careful presentation and analysis of land law and conveyancing in practice and lays a foundation for the development and further understanding of conveyancing processes in light of recent constitutional and statutory developments in Kenya. This book is an attempt therefore to assess the present state of land law and conveyancing while taking into account recent developments which include the promulgation of a novel constitutional order in 2010, the enactment of Land Act, 2012, the Land Registration Act, 2012, and the National Land Commission Act, 2012.

ebooks.title: Cases and Statutes on Evidence in Sierra Leone
ebooks.description: The Law of Evidence in Sierra Leone is largely the common law as introduced in this jurisdiction in colonial days with few inroads made by statutes on the common law principles. As such though the majority of the cases were decided in the 1960s and 1970s they are still of binding effect.

ebooks.title: Mastering Legal Research
ebooks.description: Research is defined by the Oxford Dictionary as the careful study of a subject in order to discover new facts or information about it. It has also been described as a process or steps that are used to collect and analyze information to increase the existing information about that issue. These definitions suggest that what is researched is as important as the process or method of research that is adopted. Research is basically an organized quest to find answers or information about something.

ebooks.title: Essentials of Criminal Procedure in Kenya
ebooks.description: Written in a clear, concise and engaging style this book presents the entire criminal process in a simple, yet authoritative and informative way. The core principles that underpin the criminal procedure, their rationale and assumptions are well articulated and critiqued. In addition the book presents by way of illustration a comprehensive range of the latest local judicial decisions.

ebooks.title: Devolution in Kenya: A Commentary
ebooks.description: The adoption of the 2010 Constitution by Kenyans resulted in a multifaceted governance structure, and a complex system of intergovernmental relationships, under a devolved government. It marked the ultimate realisation of the aspiration of the Kenyan people for the devolution of governance powers and functions under a new social contract. This publication is a timely, valuable and highly commendable assemblage of well researched essays on Kenya’s system of devolved governance.

ebooks.title: Annotated Civil Procedure and Practice in the Court of Appeal of Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book serves as a resource material in the area of administration of civil justice in the Court of Appeal of Tanzania. It also seeks to stimulate debate on the development of jurisprudence of the Court of Appeal in the administration of civil justice and on how the Court has applied its rules of procedure in appeals before it.

ebooks.title: Essay in Land Law Tanzania
ebooks.description: This is a book of essays on significant themes of the Land Law of Tanzania. Throughout history, the land policy and land tenure were devised in order to facilitate plantation agriculture and peasant agriculture. In that pursuit the state has consistently vested in itself extensive supervisory powers over land. The Judiciary, on its part, has willingly granted to the executive all necessary support required.

ebooks.title: Criminal Homicide in Uganda
ebooks.description: Violence has been common in the past, and it is common in most contemporary societies today. Collective violence in the form of wars and civil riots, as well as in political upheavals, may involve thousands of individual acts of assault, murder, and arson. The origin and the nature of collective violence on the whole, however, differs markedly from individual acts of violence such as criminal homicide, assault, and forcible rape, all of which involve the accomplishment of a personal objective through a violent act, whether it is an argument, personal dispute, or sexual intercourse. Criminological research on crimes of violence has been carried out primarily in the developed countries, particularly in the United States, Great Britain, and Italy. From this research we have learned that most acts of violence grow out of an interaction situation in which the act comes to be defined as requiring violence and in which the victim plays a part in precipitating the resulting action.

ebooks.title: Concept of Civil Procedure in Kenya
ebooks.description: The book lays emphasis on the understanding of the civil law and how the courts of law have interpreted it hence showing a recap of ratio decidendi decided on by the courts of law. A wider interpretation of the civil procedure rules has been echoed on to enable scholars and researchers understand the law with minimal efforts to their research.

ebooks.title: Criminal Law
ebooks.description: This text is designed to expose the Kenyan law on criminal responsibility and to define the common and key offences created by Kenyan statutes. An attempt has been made to rely mainly on Kenyan case law, but there is reference to cases from the other East African countries and the rest of the Commonwealth. The book is meant for law students undertaking the LL.B. programme. Legal practitioners, judicial officers, law enforcement agents and other persons with an interest in criminal law and justice will also find it useful.

ebooks.title: Child Rights and the Law in East Africa
ebooks.description: The book seeks to streamline the rights and protection of children in the three common law East African countries through law both now and in the future. The book also serves as a resource material in the area of child rights and the law, not only in East Africa, but also across Sub-Saharan Africa. It further seeks to stimulate debate on effective domestication and implementation of international child rights standards in East Africa.

ebooks.title: Civil Procedure and Practice in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book seeks to provide a means of understanding the concepts of civil litigation, promoting an understanding of fundamental principles involved, so that the various rules which govern civil litigation can be more easily understood and applied.

ebooks.title: Contract Law
ebooks.description: Contract law is the foundation of all commercial law. It is a subject that law students meet in their first year of study. This book is intended as an introduction to the law that governs contracts in Kenya. While the common law of England continues to play an important role, there is a rich jurisprudence and an array of Kenyan cases that have significantly contributed to the law, a number of which have been discussed. This book is largely aimed at undergraduate students of law; as such, it takes a more descriptive, rather than a critical approach explaining the law as it is, though practitioners and lecturers of law will also find it useful. There have also been some changes in legislation that will undoubtedly have an impact or encroach on contract. The most significant in this regard is perhaps the Consumer Protection Act, 2012, in so far as consumer transactions are concerned.

ebooks.title: Digest on Industrial Court Case Law
ebooks.description: This Digest endeavours to summarise the holdings of various Judges of the Industrial Court and further, exclusively narrows down to summarizing the pertinent ratio decidendi in select decided cases at the Industrial Court between the period May 2012 when the new court commenced operation to December 2013, conveniently divided into topics and sub-titles for ease of reference.

ebooks.title: Civil Procedure in Tanzania: A Student’s Manual
ebooks.description: Few areas of the law in East Africa suffer from as much a dearth of local textbooks as the Civil Procedure Law. This is often a handicap to a student; he often has no alternative but to rely on statutory provisions covering the subject and on Indian and English law. This book is an attempt to fill that void. It is, of course, not an exhaustive work on the subject, but it covers, in as concise a form as possible, most of the basic principles of the law of Civil Procedure as contained in local statutes and decisions of superior courts. Inevitably, owing to a dearth of local authorities on some topics, reference has also been made to English and Indian authorities where these have appeared to be sufficiently relevant to East Africa.

ebooks.title: Criminology in Africa
ebooks.description: Criminology in Africa has been produced with contributions from leading African authors who have focussed on the various problems facing Africa today regarding crime and criminal justice, and they have, at the same time, put forward their ideas and suggestions for coming to terms with these massive problems

ebooks.title: African Customary Law: Developing an African Jurisprudence
ebooks.description: The dichotomy between the State laws and the reflection of true African social life of the people is quite eminent. Certain legal values that have been enshrined by the ancestors and have been persistently passed on from one generation to the next by elders, through oral traditions, have been binding on the members of respective communities from time immemorial. Reviving the long debate on the need for the study of the African customary law therefore is timely and worthwhile.

ebooks.title: Employment and Labour Law Relations in Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book consists of 'the new Labour Law of Tanzania'. It contains interesting contributions drawing together a wide range of labour law pedigree influence by two major sets of colonial legacy, Germany and British.

ebooks.title: An Outline of Criminal Procedure in Kenya
ebooks.description: This book is written for Law Students, Practitioners, Judicial Officers and Academics. It is written as a Handbook to be resorted to for quick reference. At the same time, it provides comprehensive treatment of the subject. Elucidation, analysis and exposition of basic requirements of procedure and aspects of criminal law, criminology and penology that are germane have been employed and dovetailed to help deal with Kenyan Criminal Procedure.

ebooks.title: Dictionary of Criminology
ebooks.description: In professional disciplines, just as in academics, the definition of basic concepts is fundamental for adequate understanding of issues. A dictionary of criminology may be regarded as irrelevant for the simple reason that criminology cannot be said to constitute an academic or professional discipline in East Africa. But this dictionary is not limited to criminological or sociological concepts alone. Just like any academic discipline, it covers other areas of social studies such as law, economics and politics.

ebooks.title: Law of Succession
ebooks.description: This text broadly and comprehensively covers the area of law of succession in Kenya. It exposes the substantive succession legal regime applying in Kenya as well as the Kenyan probate practice.

ebooks.title: Accounting for Lawyers
ebooks.description: This book recognizes the fear faced by many law students and to a great extent the practicing lawyer concerning accounting and seeks to provide a basic and simplifi ed understanding to accounting principles for those who have no previous accounting background while at the same time introducing some advanced topics for students with previous exposure and thus a deeper scope of accounting principles. The book also sought to incorporate key accounting principles and relevant changes and developments in the Kenyan industry. A comprehensive glossary of terms has been provided to assist learners in grasping key meanings and explanations

ebooks.title: Arbitration Law and Practice in Kenya
ebooks.description: In this book, the authors have focused on the salient principles of both substantive and procedural law governing arbitration in Kenya. As the economy grows disputes between investors will gradually increase. Besides, the growth of regional and sub-regional trade agreements and the proliferation of bilateral investment treaties will spur the emergence of disputes that require resolution through arbitration.

ebooks.title: A Guide to the Laws of Kenya
ebooks.description: This “A Guide to The Laws of Kenya”, it is hoped, will enable all enquiring Kenyans to understand and appreciate the basic and rudimentary laws of our country. Hopefully, the book will help all Kenyans appreciate the laws better and by doing so citizens will be able to enforce their rights, obtain redress meaningfully and make the Kenyan society a proud one in which to prosper.

ebooks.title: Administration of Justice in Mainland Tanzania
ebooks.description: This book aims to provide a clear exposition of the nature, structure, practice and procedure of the courts in Mainland Tanzania. It provides a detailed exposition of and discussion on the nature and structure and the main areas of practice and procedure of the Courts.

ebooks.title: A Text Book on Tax Law in Kenya
ebooks.description: A Text Book on Tax Law in Kenya is a treatise on Kenyan tax law. It is a reference book for the training of advocates, accountants, tax agents, consultants, business owners, public among other professionals interacting with tax matters. It is an indispensable handbook for any professional pursuing a career in tax including the decision makers, Judges, Magistrates, and Tax Tribunals. It is an extensive summary of the tax law in Kenya and the tax jurisprudence emanating from Kenyan Courts and Tax Appeal Tribunal.

ebooks.title: Judicial Hints on Civil Procedure
ebooks.description: Civil practice and procedure in this country is shrouded in some mystique. There is frequent judicial comment that the provisions relating to civil procedure are unnecessarily complicated, often obscure, in an unsatisfactory state, delay justice, raise difficulties which have no substance although costly and pregnant with hardship and render the construction of the legislation something of a nightmare. Sometimes a dozen injustices are perpetrated from misaprehension, inadvertence, ignorance, or deliberate calculation and manipulation of the complicated rules. So complex, difficult and obscure are the rules that there are very highly learned judges who would cheerfully try a man for a serious crime on intricate evidence but who would run a mile before trying the simplest civil case. (Please do not regard this observation as an exercise in a piece of lese majeste). This state of affairs is detrimental to the public interest in general and to the rightful claims of any given litigant as his case is not investigated and determined by the courts with timeous speed, inexpensively with effective and plainly visible justice.

ebooks.title: Judicial Review Law Procedure and Practice
ebooks.description: The book discusses the law on the subject of Judicial Review in Kenya as at February, 2012.

ebooks.title: A Guide to Criminal Procedure in Uganda
ebooks.description: This book has been written primarily for Police Officers, Public Prosecutors and Magistrates who bear the main responsibility for enforcing the law and administration of criminal justice. Police Officers will find the Chapters on Police Investigations, arrest, searches, and charges of special interest. Public Prosecutors should derive ample guidance from the Chapters on conduct of public prosecutions, control of public prosecutions, constitutional rights of accused persons, attendance of witness, conduct of trial before Magistrates’ Courts, and examination of witness. Magistrates should benefit by reading especially chapters on jurisdiction, pleas, bail, conduct of trials, preliminary proceedings, judgment, appeals and sentencing process.

ebooks.title: Crime and Deviance
ebooks.description: The main objective of the first edition is to make available a simplified, readily available introductory reader not only for the students of Criminology, but also for the general reader who may be interested in the problems of crime, crime control and prevention.

ebooks.title: Judicial Review in Kenya
ebooks.description: The importance of judicial review of administrative action to Kenya cannot be gainsaid. Kenya faces a burgeoning administrative structure in an environment in which “good governance” is yet to take root fully. Fashioned specifically to check excess of and lapses in, administrative action, judicial review is tailor-made for Kenyan circumstances, as they exist today.

ebooks.title: Introduction to Tax Law - Revised Edition
