ebooks.description: This is an introductory book on taxation in East Africa. It is meant to provide reference material for students in Tax law and commerce. Practitioners in tax law and international business will also find this book invaluable. The general reader will also find the book a source of useful information.

ebooks.title: Introduction to Judicial Practice and Administration
ebooks.description: This book titled: Introduction to Judicial Administration and Court Management comes at the right time in Tanzania and perhaps East Africa. For a very a long time there were complaints that the judiciary in Tanzania and other East African countries alike are overwhelmed with cases that they do not have the capacity to determine on time. To respond to this the Tanzanian judiciary decided to adopt a strategic court management system which blends leadership and justice delivery. The system was made operational by introduction of the Judiciary Act, 2011. The changes were imminent and aimed at effective justice delivery system.

ebooks.title: Founding the Constitution of Uganda
ebooks.description: The book is designed to provide basic materials to any disinterested reader of literature on public affairs or civic studies in Uganda. The materials are recommended for general reading but may be of use to students and politicians as well as lawyers and social scientists. It is also hoped that the essays and materials will be of some use to the Constitution makers, the crafters as well as those who will be able to interpret it in years to come.

ebooks.title: International Human Rights and their Enforcement in Africa
ebooks.description: The main objective and purpose of this book therefore is to underscore the challenges besetting the effective enforcement of international human rights law in Africa and the prospects and promises of an effective regional human rights system. The book, a revised and updated version of my earlier book entitled The African System on Human and Peoples’ Rights: Its Promises, Prospects and Pitfalls, captures succinctly the recent developments of the system, since the publication of its predecessor. This is done with the understanding that the African human rights system is gradually progressing, despite the fact that it is not only the least developed but also the least effective as compared with its American and European counterparts.

ebooks.title: General Principles of Law of Contract in Tanzania
ebooks.description: The subject of Contract Law is very important in the academic curriculum and so it is in the professional spheres. The syllabi of almost all Universities in the world have a compulsory paper on the General Principles of Law of Contract followed by the rules of Law on Specific Contracts. The importance of the subject in the professional sphere lies in the fact that all transactions of social and economic nature have their beginnings in the understanding reached by the people.

ebooks.title: The Freedom of Speech for Members of Parliament in Tanzania
ebooks.description: The idea of writing a work on the ‘Freedom of Speech for Members of Parliament in Tanzania’ did not emerge from abstract; rather it arose out of a concrete situation which happened in August 2007 in Tanzania’s Parliamentary House. The incident generated a political backlash. Noise was made, demonstrations were conducted and public rallies were held. Even those citizens who traditionally do not make follow up of politics became aware that something had happened. The news of the event occupied front page headlines of most dailies in Tanzania.

ebooks.title: Family Law in Kenya: Marriage, Divorce and Children
ebooks.description: Family Law in Kenya in so far as it relates to Marriage, Divorce and Children – the focus of this book has been in an unsatisfactory state and calling for reform for a number of decades. Attempts at legislative reform often floundered as successive male-dominated Parliaments rejected them. They finally became a reality when a new constitutional order was promulgated under the Constitution of Kenya, 2010. The new era made possible the enactment of a new statutory framework for marriage, with its antecedents and consequences, as well as matrimonial property with its ownership and distribution.

ebooks.title: Family Law Digest - Matrimonial Property
ebooks.description: This Case Law Digest covers cases that have raised signifi cant or core value issues in Property Rights between spouses spanning three decades up to 2002. The editorial analysis is provided in light of the triple provisions of the Married Women’s Property Act, local statutes and applicable common law. The Convention on the Elimination of all forms of Discrimination Against Women is appended.

ebooks.title: Homicide and its Social Causes
ebooks.description: At the fifth United Nations Congress on The Prevention of Crime and the Treatment of Offenders held at Geneva in September 1975, delegates from many countries expressed great concern over the increase of crime, especially violent crimes in those countries. Japan and East Germany were the two countries that specifically reported a decline in crime. This escalation indicates that the increase in crime is a world-wide phenomenon. But the problem in Africa is how to determine whether there is or there is not an increase of crime in a given country.

ebooks.title: Forensic ICT
ebooks.description: This book provides the principal ideas and developments in the practice of the Forensic ICT Investigations. It is a fact that Information Communication Technology (ICT) crimes have proliferated; therefore the significance of proper identifications, care and processing of digital evidence needs to be taken seriouslyy. Digital Forensic evidence form the silent witness against the offender, they are factual and cannot perjure themselves. This text provides substantive information relating to computer crimes, how they are committed, what evidence is left behind and forensics techniques. It is a suitable text for computer security managers, investigators, lawyers, and auditors to equip themselves to deal with these crime challenges of our time.

ebooks.title: A Commentary on the Evidence Act Cap 80
ebooks.description: This Textbook is an authoritative, comprehensive and highly readable introduction to the law of evidence in Kenya. It is a systematic and balanced commentary on the Evidence Act Cap. 80 written with great clarity and conciseness. It covers all major topics in the law of evidence in sufficient detail but avoids being superfluous. This book is recommended reading for the able and enquiring student and a convenient reference work for practitioners of the law of evidence.

ebooks.title: A Commentary on the Civil Procedure Act Cap 21
ebooks.description: This book presents a detailed and practical explanation of the law of Civil Procedure in Kenya. It is designed primarily as a textbook for the undergraduate and Bar candidate in universities and related institutions. The book discusses the principles of Civil Procedure Law in an easily grasped and comprehensive format in a practical setting making it also useful to members of the Bar and Bench. The Second Edition has been thoroughly revised.

ebooks.title: Employment and Industrial Relations Law in Uganda
ebooks.description: By 2006, labour and Employment laws in Uganda had been crying out for a new breath of life. In April 2006, the government of Uganda enacted a number of labour laws and for the first time in the history of this country, fundamental pro-worker laws were passed to reflect the already recognized internationally labour standards.

ebooks.title: Law of Financial Institutions in Kenya
ebooks.description: The law of financial institutions in Kenya is contained in statutes as well as case law. The common law of England also plays an important role in the substantive law. Banking practice is elevated to the position of law (almost). The Central Bank of Kenya has powers to make guidelines and directives for the financial sector. When this is done, they operate within the confines of the law as the same are applied under the provisions of the Central Bank of Kenya Act, the Banking Act and the other relevant Acts.

ebooks.title: Key Issues in Jurisprudence
ebooks.description: This book gives an in-depth discourse on Jurisprudence problems to the student/reader of Jurisprudence and also gives the reader some guidance on how to approach sample questions in Jurisprudence. Most of the sample questions herein are drawn from the past examination papers of the various Universities offering law in Uganda.

ebooks.title: A Casebook on the Law of Succession
ebooks.description: This text broadly and comprehensively covers the area of law of succession in Kenya. It exposes the substantive succession legal regime applying in Kenya as well as the Kenyan probate practice by way of case law and materials. It is tailored specifically for the legal practitioner, the Magistrate and Judge and the law student.
